card.name: Units after a small dose number
card.fires_on: The unit word (mL, gram, mg) right after a small amount like 1 or 0.6, mostly for ritonavir or other co-listed ingredients in dose tables and ingredient lists.

modes.label: Unit after small amount
modes.description: mL, gram or mg directly after a number such as 1, 1.25 or 0.1 in a dosing or composition list.

modes.label: Digit starting a dose
modes.description: The first digit of a dose number in a tablet regimen.
modes.example: rifapentine tablets <<6>>00 mg once weekly for 4
